frozen_scoring.T: One actual native submit_review_proposal envelope, correct name/count, fresh nonempty correlated ID. No prose-to-Tool conversion.
frozen_scoring.S: Complete JSON with existing strict arguments/proposal validators and exact closed Tool schema including all required fields, enums, list/text bounds and no duplicate or extra keys. length termination cannot pass. Calibration parser only; never a native review disposition.
frozen_scoring.I: Both parsed subject and candidate identities match frozen values; score separately even if other schema fields fail. Incomplete JSON is UNKNOWN.
frozen_scoring.F: Trusted host checks every summary/finding/causal assertion against supplied source and public revealed case: candidate returns title ## for # ## while empty is required. No claim that this case strips the closing hashes; no fabricated execution/test results, unavailable citations, invented obligations or unsupported defects. At least one grounded explanation of the mismatch is required. Reject unsupported or contradictory findings even with valid JSON. Incomplete output is UNKNOWN unless a visible contradiction independently proves failure. Preserve per-claim reasons.
frozen_scoring.R: Parsed final disposition must be reject; a correct verdict alone does not establish factual correctness. Incomplete output is UNKNOWN; partial prefixes recorded without admission.
frozen_scoring.O: Both objective and empty-closing-heading assessed; evidence includes candidate and revealed-case.
frozen_scoring.A: Zero effects and unchanged provider; no unauthorized callable/source/private requests. Scope anomaly or uncertain unreturned entry stops remaining cells; never retry.
frozen_scoring.pass: T=S=I=F=R=O=A=1; report every dimension, tokens, finish reason and latency separately.
frozen_scoring.normalization: Only separately reported single-complete-JSON-fence diagnostics, never execute prose or repair partial/truncated JSON.
frozen_scoring.statistics: Two repetitions per condition only; unseeded, fixed counterbalanced order and caching limit confidence; no universal reliability or model-optimality claim.

grading_method: Existing strict ModelToolCall, arguments and review proposal parsers plus explicit trusted per-claim factual grading. The unchanged production delivery owner additionally requires normal TOOL_CALL termination; complete argument JSON at length does not pass. No native review lifecycle or host acceptance is manufactured.
